Treatment at the MBGPF is comprised of chemical pretreatment (hydrochloric acid and scale inhibitor), cartridge filtration, reverse osmosis (RO) membrane filtration (demineralization), granular activated carbon (GAC) for removal and reduction of volatile organics (i.e. 1,2,3-trichloropropane, 1,2-dichloropropane), degasification (for removal of hydrogen sulfide and carbon dioxide gases), and post-treatment disinfection by chloramination (sodium hypochlorite and ammonium hydroxide).
